positions.title: Systems Analyst (System Requirements, System Design Planning)
positions.description:
• Delegation of reports data turnaround time was greatly improved thru quick and  easy access to 
   sales/consumer analytics by upgrading back-end technologies and more intuitive dashboards UI.

• Achieved quick escalation of reports and system problems from users by providing a centralized portal 
   with real-time monitoring and emails notification to respective organizations.

• Identifies systems problem and proposes solution to improve efficiency and productivity of the HR and 
   Lab research teams' manual data handling and report processing.

projects.title: E-commerce (clothing store)
projects.description:
A complex React project that showcase React's fundamentals to complex functionalities, API consumption from a 3rd party Database, Authentication with Google.

projects.title: Acommerce
projects.description:
A travel e-commerce website developed using Angular as a single page application. This is a team project made during my last stack in Coding Dojo bootcamp. Core contribution was the dynamic filtering and selection of products using RxJS library  and Angular Material and Bootstrap 4 for design and responsiveness.

Technology used: MEAN ( Mongo, Express, Angular, Node)
